camera_travel_vs_static_hold.takeaway: Continuous 3D camera travel dominates at 89.3% of all shots. True static holds account for only 10.7%.

camera_speed_measurements.recommended_target_speed: 4.5 to 6.5 px/frame (0.22 - 0.32 m/s) for narrative shots; 12.0 - 24.0 px/frame (0.58 - 1.16 m/s) for whip pans

seamless_whip_pan.description: Rapid pan (>14 px/f) linking two subjects or action beats without a hard cut.

push_in_dolly.description: Z-axis forward travel into scene, increasing subject intimacy and visual tension.

static_hold.description: Locked camera with minimal sub-pixel micro-jitter (<0.9 px/f), reserved for punchline holds or shock reactions.

orbit_arc.description: Rotational arc/yaw around midground character or object, showcasing 3D geometry volume.

tracking_lateral.description: X-axis lateral trucking across scene, revealing environment details with strong ground parallax.

crane_drop_or_rise.description: Y-axis pedestal/boom vertical movement, revealing vertical scale or descending from sky to subject.

foreground_parallax.rule: Foreground props pass within 0.8-1.5 units of camera, moving at 2.5x to 6.0x the angular velocity of the background.

midground_character_staging.framing_standard: Medium shots frame character at 28-35% of frame height; close-ups frame character at 50-65% height. Ground line placed at lower 25-35% of frame.

background_depth_and_haze.rule: Midground subject is 2.2x to 3.5x sharper than distant background. Distant background undergoes 25-40% contrast attenuation towards atmospheric studio backdrop.

world_composition_3d_rules: 1. Real 3D Mesh Geometry: Strictly zero flat 2D strips, planar billboards, or cardboard facade cutouts. Every building, vehicle, prop, and terrain feature is modeled as a true 3D volumetric mesh with depth, thickness, and bevels.
2. Stylized Painted Textures: Surfaces use hand-painted or solid-color diffuse shading with subtle ambient gradient maps, avoiding photorealistic procedural noise.
3. Dark Ink Outlines: All 3D assets feature prominent unlit ink silhouette contours (colors #1b1817 to #2e2520, 3-5px solid core at 720p) matching the character's vector line art aesthetic.
4. Multi-Layer Spatial Clearance: Scenes must have a defined 3-tier depth structure: near foreground props (<1.5m), midground interaction zone (2.0-3.5m), and far background scenery (>5.0m).

5. In-World Physical Signage: All on-screen text, statistics, or labels must be physical objects inside the 3D scene (carved wooden signs, painted metal placards, stenciled crate text) rather than floating screen-space HUD graphics.
